digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) management and indexing
propositions: 17 collision groups exist across 91 ADR files (69 distinct numbers), with the most severe collision being 5 unrelated ADRs numbered 0037

The root cause is stale-base rebases rather than in-flight races; a pre-merge CI check cannot prevent them, but per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/ create git add/add conflicts that Rebase-If-Necessary cannot auto-resolve
22 duplicate-numbered ADRs must be renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order, with the earliest-landed ADR in each collision group keeping its original number
All slug-bearing cross-references across docs/ and src/ that name a moved ADR must be rewritten to its new 0070-0091 number; bare prose ADR citations without slugs remain advisory
The referential-integrity check must fail (exit non-zero) if any markdown link `](adr/NNNN-slug)` dangles or if ADR<->marker bijection is violated
